# spydersoftidentity_client (Resource)

An OAuth2/OpenID Connect client. Secrets are managed with spydersoftidentity_client_secret. Import with the OAuth client_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spydersoftidentity_client" "example" {
  client_id   = "example-web"
  client_name = "Example web app"

  allowed_grant_types = ["authorization_code"]
  allowed_scopes      = ["openid", "profile", spydersoftidentity_scope.example.name]
  redirect_uris       = ["https://app.example.com/signin-oidc"]

  post_logout_redirect_uris = ["https://app.example.com/signout-callback-oidc"]
  allowed_cors_origins      = ["https://app.example.com"]
  allow_offline_access      = true

  # Claims may repeat a type with different values.
  claims = [
    { type = "role", value = "reader" },
    { type = "role", value = "writer" },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) The OAuth client_id.
- `client_name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `absolute_refresh_token_lifetime` (Number) Absolute refresh token lifetime in seconds.
- `access_token_lifetime` (Number) Access token lifetime in seconds.
- `access_token_type` (Number) Access token type: 0 = JWT, 1 = reference.
- `allow_access_tokens_via_browser` (Boolean) Allow access tokens to be returned via the browser.
- `allow_offline_access` (Boolean) Allow refresh tokens (offline_access).
- `allow_plain_text_pkce` (Boolean) Allow the plain PKCE code challenge method.
- `allow_remember_consent` (Boolean) Allow users to remember consent decisions.
- `allowed_cors_origins` (Set of String) Allowed CORS origins.
- `allowed_grant_types` (Set of String) Allowed grant types, e.g. authorization_code, client_credentials.
- `allowed_scopes` (Set of String) Scopes (API scopes, identity resources) the client may request.
- `always_include_user_claims_in_id_token` (Boolean) Include user claims in the ID token even when an access token is requested.
- `always_send_client_claims` (Boolean) Always send client claims, not only for client_credentials.
- `authorization_code_lifetime` (Number) Authorization code lifetime in seconds.
- `back_channel_logout_session_required` (Boolean) Whether the session id is sent on back-channel logout.
- `back_channel_logout_uri` (String) Back-channel logout URI.
- `claims` (Attributes Set) Claims added to tokens issued to this client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claims))
- `client_claims_prefix` (String) Prefix for client claims.
- `client_uri` (String) URI of a page with information about the client.
- `consent_lifetime` (Number) Consent lifetime in seconds; unset means no expiry.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `device_code_lifetime` (Number) Device code lifetime in seconds.
- `enable_local_login` (Boolean) Allow local (username/password) login.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the client is enabled.
- `front_channel_logout_session_required` (Boolean) Whether the session id is sent on front-channel logout.
- `front_channel_logout_uri` (String) Front-channel logout URI.
- `identity_provider_restrictions` (Set of String) Identity providers the client may use; empty means all.
- `identity_token_lifetime` (Number) Identity token lifetime in seconds.
- `include_jwt_id` (Boolean) Include a jti claim in access tokens.
- `logo_uri` (String) URI of the client logo.
- `pair_wise_subject_salt` (String) Salt for pair-wise subject identifiers.
- `post_logout_redirect_uris` (Set of String) Allowed post-logout redirect URIs.
- `properties` (Map of String) Custom key/value properties.
- `protocol_type` (String) Protocol type.
- `redirect_uris` (Set of String) Allowed redirect URIs.
- `refresh_token_expiration` (Number) Refresh token expiration: 0 = sliding, 1 = absolute.
- `refresh_token_usage` (Number) Refresh token usage: 0 = re-use, 1 = one-time only.
- `require_client_secret` (Boolean) Whether the client must present a secret at the token endpoint.
- `require_consent` (Boolean) Whether a consent screen is required.
- `require_pkce` (Boolean) Whether authorization code flows require PKCE.
- `sliding_refresh_token_lifetime` (Number) Sliding refresh token lifetime in seconds.
- `update_access_token_claims_on_refresh` (Boolean) Refresh access token claims when a refresh token is used.
- `user_code_type` (String) User code type for the device flow.
- `user_sso_lifetime` (Number) Maximum SSO lifetime in seconds; unset means no limit.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier assigned by the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the OAuth client_id.
terraform import spydersoftidentity_client.example example-web
```
